category: Equity Oriented Investment Strategies - Sector Rotation Long-Short Fund
scheme_objective:
To generate capital appreciation in long term by predominantly investing in equity and equity related securities including limited short exposure through unhedged 
derivative positions, of maximum four sectors.
There is no assurance that the investment objective of the 
Investment strategy will be achieved.

expenses_and_loads.exit_load:
Entry Load nil, Exit Load:• 1% of applicable Net Asset Value - If units purchased or switched in from another scheme of the fund are redeemed or switched out within 1 month from the date of investment.• Nil-If units purchased or switched in from another scheme of the fund are redeemed or switched out after 1 month from the date of investment.The Trustees shall have a right to prescribe or modify the exit load structure with prospective effect subject to the 
max prescribed under the Regulations.
